column3: Saori Route ・ A Flood of Feelings
Kyo... Kyousuke-shi...
H-Here...
What's this?
Saori surreptitiously handed over a number of photos.
Let's see, they're pictures of...
...Saori.
And it's her non-swirly glasses version.
And what's more, full maid cosplay?
S-Saori?  What...
Uuuu, uuuu, uuuu...
Calm down. Calm down, Saori!
If I had to say it, although I prefer girls with glasses, your natural look is pretty amazing!
And seeing a proper lady exposed bare brings up a flood of feelings!
Kyosuke-shi, you need to calm down too!
Gah, a precision counter?!
And it looks like there's more...
Ohhhhh?!
The second picture.
Most definitely... a cosplay of a certain famous anime character.
Rather than the perfection of her cosplay, continuing to see Saori's unobstructed face is like a treat for the eyes ... I mean, bad for the heart.
This is what I totally think. The guy who invented the idea of taking off glasses to reveal a beautiful girl was a great person.
But! Even still, I prefer girls with glasses...
Gah!
And then the third photo.
By the way, what would society think of a guy who, while standing before a high school girl, stares at pictures of said high school girl in a swimsuit?!
Not just a pervert-in-waiting, but pervert in training, right?!
Somebody should call the cops on me.
S-Saori... what is this...
There's more...
There's still one last picture...
The last picture...
The maid costume, the anime character cosplay, the bikini...
The gulp of my nervous swallowing rang in my ears.
Would the hero quit before the long awaited last boss?
But, if I retreated here, I couldn't be considered a man!
Hnnnggg!
Bu-ha-hwoooo!
You! What! This! Huh?!
The long awaited last boss easily broke through our aerial defenses.
Feels like I'm starting to knock on the forbidden door...
I tried very hard...
And I was like a famous pro-cosplayer...
Showing myself!
Didn't you work hard on the wrong thing?!
Uuuu, uuuu, uuuu...
If... If you say that all this wasn't enough...
If not, then only the female Micro Bikini armor could...
Okay, okay, I understand!
I tooootally understand how hard you tried!
But this isn't something you should do as a woman who's about to get married!
That's the thing...
Huh?!
If I threw away my modesty, my new self would be truly free...
I took those photos while believing that.
The first cosplays were taken in preparation for the last one.
Ah.. Ahaha... AHAHAHAHAHA!
Saori?! Saori!!
